subject: GLC This Week: Take it Easy Tuesday, Kitchen Table Talks, wellness check-ins
text:
THE GOOD LIFE CENTER | LAST WEEK BEFORE BREAK

MON 11/16
- Craft et Veritas: collages. 3-4pm, YSC Offline Oasis
- Gentle Yoga. 5-6pm, YSC Dance Studio

TUE 11/17
- Take it Easy Tuesday (YC3). 2-4pm, YSC Good Life Center Lounge
- NEW: Kitchen Table Talks, a YC3 conversation series on the Living Room Conversations model. First session 6-7pm, MENA Cultural Community, 305 Crown St

WED 11/18
- 10-minute wellness appointments. 10:15am-5pm, YSC Offline Oasis. Sign up in person from 10:15am.

The GLC closes Thu 11/19 at 3pm and reopens Mon 11/30.

Be well,
The Good Life Center
